title: Design Review Annotation
description: Annotation file created by plan-architect after reviewing a design document for completeness. Used to cache review results and skip redundant reviews.

feature.description: Feature name this review pertains to

design_doc_path.description: Path to the design document that was reviewed

design_doc_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the design document content for change detection. If document changes, review should be re-run.

status.description: Review outcome: 'complete' means ready for planning, 'has_gaps' means user must address issues first

gaps_identified.description: List of gaps found in the design document (only present if status is 'has_gaps')

location.description: Section or line reference in the design document

why_it_matters.description: Codebase context that makes this gap relevant (e.g., existing patterns that need consideration)

severity.description: blocking = cannot proceed, should_address = highly recommended, minor = optional improvement

codebase_context_refs.description: Paths to relevant code that informed the review

recommendations.description: Brief suggestions for the user or next planning steps

reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when review was completed

reviewed_by.description: Agent ID that performed the review (e.g., 'plan-architect-abc123')

sequential_thinking_used.description: Whether Sequential Thinking MCP was used for this review

review_duration_ms.description: Time taken to complete the review in milliseconds
